title: Curable resin composition containing polymer fine particles with improved storage stability
abstract: A curable resin composition containing, with respect to 100 parts by mass of an epoxy resin (A), 1-100 parts by mass of polymer fine particles (B) having a core-shell structure in which a core layer is a diene rubber, and a component (B) The content of the epoxy group in it is 0.01-0.2 mmol/g. However, the 1st curable resin composition (I) contains 0.5-30 mass parts of inorganic fillers (C), and (C) component is fumed silica. Moreover, (A) component of 2nd curable resin composition (II) contains a bisphenol A type epoxy resin and a rubber-modified epoxy resin and/or a urethane-modified epoxy resin.
